mythVsFact.myth: Travel vaccinations are only needed for tropical countries.
mythVsFact.fact: Vaccination recommendations depend on destination, activities and personal circumstances — not latitude alone.

mythVsFact.myth: One appointment is always enough before any trip.
mythVsFact.fact: Some vaccines require multiple doses over several weeks — last-minute travel may limit full protection.

mythVsFact.myth: All travel vaccines are available free on the NHS.
mythVsFact.fact: Some vaccines may be NHS-funded for specific risk groups; many destination-specific vaccines are private — eligibility is confirmed at consultation.

mythVsFact.myth: Private pharmacy services guarantee faster cures.
mythVsFact.fact: Private services offer convenient access and structured assessment — outcomes depend on individual clinical circumstances.
